types.name: computed
types.description:
This method indicated that the property is a computed property.

computed on the fly.
types.example: import { model } from "@medusajs/framework/utils" const MyCustom = model.define("my_custom", { calculated_price: model.bigNumber().computed(), // ... }) export default MyCustom
